class _Rules(Rules):
    def modify_transition(self, action, raw_response, env_state):
        # Only perturb clean-type actions, at sub-10% frequency, using the
        # exact standard ALFWorld feedback string. This stays in-distribution.
        text = (action.kwargs.get("text") or "").lower()
        if "clean" not in text:
            return raw_response

        # Deterministic per-step gate using step_count to keep frequency low
        # and reproducible across rollouts.
        if env_state.step_count % 11 != 0:
            return raw_response

        # Replace the observation text with the standard failure string,
        # keep everything else (reward/terminated/info) unchanged.
        new_obs = Observation(text="Nothing happens.", data=raw_response.observation.data)
        return EnvResponse(
            observation=new_obs,
            reward=raw_response.reward,
            terminated=raw_response.terminated,
            truncated=raw_response.truncated,
            info=raw_response.info,
        )

import hashlib


class _Rules(Rules):
    """CommandNoiseSwap (O axis, harder with DOSE): with probability DOSE, swap two random
    characters within each admissible command string shown in the footer. The world and the
    actual accepted commands are untouched, so the task stays solvable by construction; the
    policy must visually decode the scrambled commands. Swaps are deterministic per step via
    sha256 so the perturbation is reproducible."""

    DOSE = 1.0
    TASK_ID = '24'

    def _swap(self, s, seed):
        if len(s) < 2:
            return s
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{seed}:{s}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        i = int(digest[:8], 16) % len(s)
        j = int(digest[8:16], 16) % len(s)
        if i == j:
            j = (j + 1) % len(s)
        lst = list(s)
        lst[i], lst[j] = lst[j], lst[i]
        return "".join(lst)

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        bucket = int(hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 10000
        if bucket >= int(self.DOSE * 10000):
            return obs
        cmds = (obs.data or {}).get("admissible_commands")
        if not cmds:
            return obs
        new_cmds = [self._swap(c, f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}:{idx}") for idx, c in enumerate(cmds)]
        data = dict(obs.data or {})
        data["admissible_commands"] = new_cmds
        text = obs.text
        for old, new in zip(cmds, new_cmds):
            text = text.replace(old, new)
        return Observation(text=text, data=data)

class _Rules(Rules):
    def modify_transition(self, action, raw_response, env_state):
        # Exercise failure-recovery: when the Policy issues an ineffective
        # action ("Nothing happens"), trim the repetition budget so it must
        # notice and recover sooner. We do NOT change observation text or
        # admissible commands -- surface presentation stays identical.
        if not env_state.last_action_was_effective:
            # Lower the repetition truncation threshold by nudging the
            # repetition counter upward, so the Bridge truncates earlier.
            env_state.repetition_count += 1
        return raw_response
